title: Exact semidegree extraction from minimum outdegree

comparators.scope: Twenty-four fixed explicit paper-facing contracts covering main theorem, dense limit, supplemental graph claims and metered construction.
The exact main graph-minimum contract is weakened by an additional False hypothesis. Rejection detail: extra False premise on P03Contract.theorem_1_1.
The fixed main theorem statement is intentionally proved through an unauthorized axiom. Rejection detail: illegal axiom in main theorem proof.

main_results.scope: Doubled integer inequality for loopless nonempty finite digraphs with feasible minimum outdegree.
Unit-capacity pair placement with row demands and column capacities, including d = 0.
For 0 < n and d < n, the graph minimum equals the least integer threshold C, with the radical/ceiling formula and a constant-outdegree extremal witness.
For 0 < alpha < 1, the finite identity, dense limit, and original liminf equal 1 − sqrt(1 − alpha²).
Vertex-and-arc-deleted subdigraphs, induced extraction equivalence, degeneracy characterization, monotonicity, strict comparisons, and endpoint expansions.
Returned adjacency list has metered primitive work at most 2048*n⁸, with looplessness, exact outdegree, optimal q, and no duplicate arcs; the bound concerns the explicit operation model.
